name: Knaebe's Mmmunchy Krunchy Apple Farm
description: In Rogers City, MI, Knaebe's Mmmunchy Krunchy Apple Farm raises Apples, Pumpkins, and Corn on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
